e: From Malay cukup (“enough”), coined by e-sports athletes in Malaysia and Singapore when competing with each other in e-sports matches.
Borrowed from Indonesian cukong, from Hokkien 主公 (chú-kong).
q: The cukong collaborates with licence holders who are indigenous Indonesians.
1993, Lee Khoon Choy, Diplomacy of a Tiny State, →ISBN, page 286:
I finally figured out what is mating on my cukes: squash bugs.
